source: captured against the installed codex-cli 0.154.0 app-server over a Unix socket
transport: WebSocket over AF_UNIX with an HTTP Upgrade handshake; not Theater NDJSON

server_response_headers.sec-websocket-accept: <RFC 6455 accept derived from the client key>

auth: no bearer or capability token is required for a unix:// control socket listener

framing.messages: one JSON document per text frame

initialize.capabilities_note: the capabilities object is optional; omitting it disables experimental methods

jsonrpc_version_field: absent by design: requests and responses carry no jsonrpc member
notes: Request ids may be integers or strings; responses echo the request id.
initialize is the only method whose error was never observed; initialize must precede thread work.
The app-server emits remoteControl/status/changed as a notification shortly after a connection initializes.
